Help-center excerpts:

[docs-statements] Monthly statements (effective 2025-01-01)
Your monthly statement is ready within 3 after the end of each month. We'll notify you when it's available.

## Download a statement

Tap Profile, then Documents, then Statements, and choose the month. Statements are PDFs.

## How far back

Seven years of statements are available in the app.

## Statement dates

Statements cover a calendar month and close on the last day of the month. The statement date matters for disputes about unauthorized transactions, which must be reported within 60 days of the statement they first appear on.

## Paper statements

## Paper statements

We don't mail paper statements, and there's no fee for any statement ($0.00).

## Savings Pockets

Pocket balances and interest appear on the same statement as your main balance.

## Something looks wrong

If a statement shows a transaction you don't recognize, tap it in the app to see the merchant details, and dispute it if you didn't make it.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[close-statements] Statements after closing (effective 2025-01-01)
interest in the year you closed, we still send your 1099-INT by January 31.

## Verification letters

Account verification letters are only available for open accounts.

## Card and transaction history

Your statements list every transaction, fee, interest payment and dispute credit for the month, so they're usually all you need for records, taxes or a loan application elsewhere.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[close-statements] Statements after closing (effective 2025-01-01)
After you close your account, you can still sign in and download statements for 90 days.

## Download them before you go

We recommend downloading any statements and tax forms you might need before you close. Tap Profile, then Documents.

## After that

Once the download period ends, you can't sign in. Message support from the sign-in screen, or email us, and we'll send the statements you need. We keep records for seven years.

## Tax forms

If you earned at least $10.00 in interest in the year you closed, we still send your 1099-INT

[account-documents] Documents for identity verification (effective 2025-01-01)
good light.

## Details

Your legal name, date of birth, residential address and Social Security number or ITIN. Your name must match your ID.

## Proof of address

If we can't confirm your address automatically, we'll ask for a document dated within the last 90 days, such as a utility bill, lease or bank statement.

## What we don't accept

Expired IDs, photocopies, student IDs, or screenshots of an ID.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

## What happens next

- If your dispute passes an initial review, you get a provisional credit within 10 business days.
- Most investigations finish within 45 days. Foreign transactions, and accounts open less than 30 days, can take up to 90 days.

## Your liability

You aren't responsible for unauthorized card transactions reported within the window.

[security-zero-liability] Zero liability for unauthorized card use (effective 2025-01-01)
You aren't responsible for unauthorized card transactions if you report them in time.

## What counts as in time

Report unauthorized card transactions within 60 days of the date of the statement they first appear on. Statements close on the last calendar day of each month.

## What's covered

- Purchases and ATM withdrawals made with your card or card number without your permission
- Mobile wallet payments made with a device you don't control

## What isn't covered

- Purchases made by someone you gave your card or PIN to
- BrookPay payments and transfers you sent yourself, even

[docs-verification-letter] Account verification letter (effective 2025-01-01)
An account verification letter confirms that you have an open account with us. Landlords, employers and government offices sometimes ask for one.

## Get a letter

Tap Profile, then Documents, then Account verification letter. The PDF is ready right away and shows your name, account number, account type and the date the account was opened.

## Showing your balance

You can choose whether the letter includes your current balance.

## Custom letters

We can't write custom letters, sign forms, or fill in third-party verification forms. The standard letter is accepted by most organizations.

## Closed accounts

Letters are only available

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
